review_candidates.title: Erpnext Developer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Trigger Solutions is a technology company focused on helping businesses achieve digital transformation through customized software solutions. The organization delivers tailored software development, integrated ERP systems, and smart accounting tools designed to streamline operations and improve decision-making. Trigger Solutions also offers practical, hands-on training courses to help teams adopt new technologies effectively. Joining the company means working in a dynamic environment that values innovation, client collaboration, and continuous learning. Role Description The ERPNext Developer will work on designing, customizing, and implementing ERPNext modules to meet client business requirements in an on-site, full-time role based in Egypt. Day-to-day responsibilities include configuring and extending ERPNext applications, integrating ERPNext with other systems, and optimizing workflows across finance, inventory, sales, and other business functions. The role involves translating functional requirements into technical specifications, writing clean and maintainable code, and performing testing, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. The ERPNext Developer will collaborate closely with consultants, business analysts, and end users, provide user support and training, and contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of ERPNext solutions. Qualifications Strong ERPNext development experience, including customization of doctypes, scripts, and reports, and configuration of core modules (e.g., Accounts, HR, Stock, Sales, Purchase). Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with solid understanding of Frappe framework, REST APIs, and integration with third-party systems. Practical knowledge of relational databases (e.g., MariaDB, MySQL), data modeling, and basic SQL for queries, migrations, and performance optimization. Experience in software development practices, including version control (Git), code review, debugging, unit testing, and documentation. Understanding of business processes such as accounting, inventory management, CRM, and project management, preferably within ERP implementations. Ability to gather requirements, analyze workflows, and translate business needs into technical solutions with a user-centered approach. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams on-site. Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience with other ERP platforms (e.g., Odoo, SAP, Oracle) and participation in end-to-end ERP implementation projects is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Assistant to Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Core HR Solutions provides integrated HR services that help organizations streamline operations, improve hiring quality, and enhance workforce performance. We handle the full spectrum of HR functions, including payroll, benefits administration, recruitment, onboarding, and employee management, so businesses can focus on strategic growth. Our recruitment capabilities cover all professional levels, from junior to executive roles, with a structured approach that ensures strong technical fit and cultural alignment. By optimizing HR workflows and maintaining compliance with labor regulations, we support better employee experiences, higher retention, and more stable workplaces. We are dedicated to long-term partnerships with organizations seeking measurable improvements in HR effectiveness and overall performance. Role Description The Assistant to Chief Executive Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. This position supports the CEO with daily executive-level administrative tasks, including calendar management, meeting scheduling, travel coordination, and preparation of agendas, presentations, and reports. The assistant will organize and prioritize correspondence, maintain confidential records, and ensure timely follow-up on key initiatives and action items. The role includes coordinating internal and external communications, liaising with senior leaders and partners, and preparing briefing materials for strategic meetings and business trips. The assistant is expected to maintain smooth office administration around the CEO, anticipate needs, and contribute to efficient decision-making and time management. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Executive Administrative Assistance and Administrative Assistance skills to support high-level leadership and handle complex tasks. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, to interact with stakeholders, draft correspondence, and prepare presentations. Candidates should possess solid Organization Skills and Office Administration capabilities to manage schedules, documents, and competing priorities effectively. Proficiency with productivity tools (e.g., MS Office Suite, calendar and email systems) and comfort with digital collaboration platforms. Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain professional judgment under pressure. Previous experience supporting C-level or senior executives in a fast-paced environment is highly beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse teams.

Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
